simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to מִפְלֶצֶת (H4656) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-f.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 4 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: מִפְלֶצֶת (miphletseth) means a terror , i.e. an idol First listed occurrence: 1Kgs 15 13.

definitions.full: H4656. miphletseth מִפְלֶ֫צֶת noun feminine horrid thing (thing to shudder at ); — מ ׳עָֽשְׂתָה לַאֲשֵׁרָה 1Kin 15:13 (of some abominable object of idolatry, not precisely known), so suffix מִפְלַצְתָּהּ 15:13 2Chr 15:16 (twice in verse).
